lemma weaveBuild (h : Imprint H d F) (B : Labels.Frame G d) :
    ∃ T : SectionData B, Portfolio H T (twist h.toCampaign) ∧
      ∀ p, T.evaluate (B.coords (twist h.toCampaign p))=reel F p := by

proof_context.conclusion: A section `T` with `Portfolio H T (twist h)` exists, and `T.evaluate (B.coords (twist p)) = reel F p`: invertibility, Taylor normalization, symmetry and unit identities, and factor bounds through `cost_reel` and `inverse_tier`.

snippet.text:
structure Portfolio {B : Frame G d} (H : Hol G) (T : SectionData B)
    (weave : Label G d ≃ₗ[ℂ] Label G d) : Prop where
  valid : T.Sound H
  pays : pop T
  currency (k P : ℕ) : ∃ A : ℝ, Credit T k P A -- to be applied in the schedule; no claim what values used
  inter (s : Signed) p : weave (theta s p)=theta s (weave p)
  truly p : weave (realBar p) = realBar (weave p)
  rank (p : Label G d) : p∈Maxwell.equationIdeal G d → Micro (T.evaluate (B.coords (weave p)))

proof_context.conclusion: `Portfolio` collects `Sound`, `pop`, `Credit` for all `k`, `P`, the commutation with signed permutations and conjugation, and `Micro` on the equation ideal.

private lemma radius_uniform {B : Frame G d} {H : Hol G} (X : SectionData B) (he : Portfolio H X (R d)) :
    ∃ r m : ℕ,∀ x : Label G d,x∈Maxwell.equationIdeal G d → MicroAt (X.evaluate (B.coords (R d x))) r m := by

proof_context.conclusion: One radius `r` and minimal side `M` work for the whole equation ideal, as the maxima over a basis.
